boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Augustana College
boards.description: Verifiable late-night dining and study spots for Augustana College students in Rock Island, Illinois.

cards.title: The Midnight C-Store
cards.subtitle: Westerlin Residence Hall
cards.notes: Grab snacks, drinks, and quick meals at this on-campus market. It stays open until midnight most nights, serving as the primary late-night hub for residential students.
cards.short_summary: On-campus convenience store open until midnight for late-night snacks.
cards.evidence_claim: Westerlin Market is open until midnight Monday-Thursday and Sunday.
cards.source_title: Dining locations and hours | Augustana College
cards.access_notes: Open until midnight Sun-Thu; closes at 8 p.m. Fri-Sat.

cards.title: Continuous Campus Dining
cards.subtitle: Gerber Center for Student Life
cards.notes: Visit the main dining hall for all-you-care-to-eat meals. It serves as a central gathering point for students finishing late labs or evening study sessions.
cards.short_summary: The primary campus dining hall offering continuous service until 8 or 9 p.m.
cards.evidence_claim: The Gerber Center Dining Room is open until 8 p.m. or 9 p.m. depending on the day.
cards.source_title: The Gerber Center for Student Life - Augustana College
cards.access_notes: Open until 8 p.m. Sun-Thu and 7 p.m. Fri-Sat; some sources indicate 9 p.m. during full sessions.

cards.title: The 4 AM Taco Run
cards.subtitle: 1533 38th Street
cards.notes: Drive over for late-night cravings. This location recently extended its hours, making it one of the few spots near campus open well past midnight on weekends.
cards.short_summary: Fast food staple near campus with extended late-night drive-thru hours.
cards.evidence_claim: The Taco Bell in Rock Island is open until 4 a.m. on Thursdays, Fridays, and Saturdays.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell® in Rock Island, IL - 1533-38th Street
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru open until 4 a.m. Thu-Sat; 2 a.m. other nights.

cards.title: Late Night Golden Arches
cards.subtitle: 2950 11th Street
cards.notes: Head to the 11th Street location for a late-night McFlurry or fries. The drive-thru remains active late into the night for off-campus students and late-night studiers.
cards.short_summary: Reliable late-night fast food with drive-thru service until 2 a.m.
cards.evidence_claim: The McDonald's on 11th Street in Rock Island has drive-thru hours until 2 a.m. daily.
cards.source_title: McDonald's | Rock Island IL
cards.access_notes: Drive-thru open until 2 a.m. daily.

cards.title: The Local Scoop
cards.subtitle: 2520 18th Avenue
cards.notes: Visit this Quad Cities institution for a late-night shake or cone. It's a popular spot for students to unwind after evening events or exams.
cards.short_summary: Famous local ice cream shop with drive-thru service open until 10 p.m. on weekends.
cards.evidence_claim: Whitey's Ice Cream in Rock Island is open until 10 p.m. on Fridays and Saturdays.
cards.source_title: Locations - Whitey's Ice Cream
cards.access_notes: Open until 10 p.m. Fri-Sat; 9 p.m. Sun-Thu.

cards.title: 24/7 Convenience Run
cards.subtitle: 1636 38th Street
cards.notes: Walk or drive to this 24-hour spot for emergency study snacks, coffee, or hot food. It is one of the few truly 24/7 options immediately adjacent to campus.
cards.short_summary: Always-open convenience store for late-night essentials.
cards.evidence_claim: The 7-Eleven at 1636 38th St in Rock Island is open 24/7.
cards.source_title: 1636 38Th St in ROCK ISLAND, IL - 7-Eleven
cards.access_notes: Open 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

cards.title: Midnight Study Sessions
cards.subtitle: Gerber Center for Student Life
cards.notes: Utilize the library's late hours for group projects or quiet study. It remains open until midnight most weeknights, providing a safe and productive environment.
cards.short_summary: Campus library offering late-night study spaces and resources.
cards.evidence_claim: Thomas Tredway Library is open until midnight Monday-Thursday and Sunday.
cards.source_title: The Gerber Center for Student Life - Augustana College
cards.access_notes: Open until midnight Sun-Thu; closes at 7 p.m. Fri and 6 p.m. Sat.

cards.title: Finals Week Fuel
cards.subtitle: Gerber Center Dining Hall
cards.notes: Join faculty and staff for a free late-night breakfast during finals week. It's a long-standing tradition to help students de-stress and refuel before exams.
cards.short_summary: A beloved finals week tradition featuring free late-night breakfast served by faculty.
cards.evidence_claim: Augustana's Midnight Breakfast is served from 10 p.m. until midnight during finals week.
cards.source_title: Midnight Breakfast, served with good humor | Augustana College
cards.access_notes: Occurs during finals week; typically 10 p.m. to midnight.

cards.title: Late Night Pizza Delivery
cards.subtitle: 1600 38th Street
cards.notes: Order a late-night pizza for delivery or carryout. Located just south of campus, it's a frequent choice for dorm parties and late-night study groups.
cards.short_summary: Nearby pizza chain offering delivery and carryout until midnight.
cards.evidence_claim: The Pizza Hut on 38th St in Rock Island is open until midnight.
cards.source_title: Delivery in Rock Island, IL - Pizza Hut
cards.access_notes: Open until midnight daily.

cards.title: The Late Night Sub
cards.subtitle: 2532 18th Avenue
cards.notes: Grab a sandwich or a baked potato at this local favorite. While not open past midnight, it serves as a popular early late-night dinner spot for students.
cards.short_summary: Local sandwich shop chain popular for quick evening meals.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hungry Hobo in Rock Island is open until 9 p.m. daily.
cards.source_title: Locations & Hours - Hungry Hobo
cards.access_notes: Open until 9 p.m. daily.

boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Discover the specific study nooks, quiet floors, and community hubs where Augustana students actually spend their time between classes.

cards.title: The High-Energy Hub
cards.subtitle: Gerber Center for Student Life
cards.notes: Grab a coffee at the Brew and find a booth in this active social hub. It is the go-to spot for group projects and mid-day breaks.
cards.short_summary: An active, social study area on the top floor of the student center featuring the campus coffee shop and group tables.
cards.evidence_claim: The Gerber Center's fourth floor is described as a social and active floor with tables, booths, and comfy chairs near the Brew by the Slough.
cards.source_title: Best study spots on campus | Augustana College
cards.access_notes: Open daily during the academic year; library hours extend to midnight Monday-Thursday.

cards.title: The Deep Work Zone
cards.subtitle: Thomas Tredway Library
cards.notes: Respect the strict quiet policy on this floor for uninterrupted focus. It is ideal for solo study sessions and final exam prep.
cards.short_summary: A designated quiet floor in the main library intended for students who require minimal distractions.
cards.evidence_claim: The third floor of the Tredway Library is officially designated as a 'quiet floor' where students do not speak to maintain focus.
cards.source_title: Space Availability - Tredway Library - LibCal - Augustana College
cards.access_notes: Quiet hours are enforced during all open library hours; closes at midnight most weeknights.

cards.title: The Science Pods
cards.subtitle: Hanson Hall of Science
cards.notes: Use the flexible furniture and rolling monitors to customize your group study space in the modern science building addition.
cards.short_summary: Modern, collaborative common areas within the science building featuring mobile furniture for group work.
cards.evidence_claim: Hanson Hall of Science provides common areas with tables, chairs, and monitors on wheels designed for active learning and collaboration.
cards.source_title: Best study spots on campus | Augustana College
cards.access_notes: Accessible to students during academic building hours; classrooms are available when not in use.

cards.title: The Lower Campus Escape
cards.subtitle: Carlsson Evald Hall
cards.notes: Head to this outdoor spot for a quiet place to work near the athletic facilities. It is a student favorite during the spring months.
cards.short_summary: A quiet outdoor patio area located at Evald Hall, favored for its proximity to lower campus facilities.
cards.evidence_claim: The Evald patio is noted as a quiet study spot with minimal distractions, particularly convenient for students near the Carver P.E. Center.
cards.source_title: Best study spots on campus | Augustana College
cards.access_notes: Open outdoor area; best used during daylight hours in fair weather.

cards.title: The Community Living Room
cards.subtitle: 3250 9th Avenue
cards.notes: Visit this house for evening study sessions or community meetings. It offers a kitchen and comfortable lounge spaces for all students.
cards.short_summary: A residential-style community space providing study areas and a full kitchen for student use.
cards.evidence_claim: The Black Culture House serves as a center for student activities including tutoring, studying, and small group discussions.
cards.source_title: Augustana's inaugural Culture Houses Block Party
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Thursday from 5 p.m. to 9 p.m. during fall and spring semesters.

cards.title: The Mural Room
cards.subtitle: 3416 9 1/2 Avenue
cards.notes: Study surrounded by student-painted murals in this welcoming space. It is a quiet alternative to the main library for evening work.
cards.short_summary: A cultural hub on campus featuring vibrant murals and dedicated spaces for tutoring and small group study.
cards.evidence_claim: Casa Latina is available for small group fellowship, tutoring, and studying, and features a collaborative wall mural.
cards.source_title: Culture houses and Culture Collective | Augustana College
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Thursday 5-9 p.m. for general student use and community events.

cards.title: The Academic Support Wing
cards.subtitle: Olin Center, Room 320
cards.notes: Stop by for academic coaching or use the quiet tables for focused tasks. It is the primary location for peer tutoring services.
cards.short_summary: The main office for academic support services, offering a structured environment for tutoring and coaching.
cards.evidence_claim: The Learning Commons main office is located in Olin 320 and provides academic coaching and tutoring services.
cards.source_title: The Learning Commons | Augustana College
cards.access_notes: Open during standard business hours; appointments for tutoring are recommended via Starfish.

cards.title: The Waterside Retreat
cards.subtitle: Swannie Slough Path
cards.notes: Take a break from the library at this scenic gazebo. It is a popular spot for reading or meeting friends along the paved campus trail.
cards.short_summary: A scenic gazebo located along the 1/4 mile Slough Path, used for relaxation and outdoor study.
cards.evidence_claim: The Slough Path is described as a spot for relaxing in the gazebo or strolling along the 1/4 mile paved pathway.
cards.source_title: Slough drainage, restoration project ensures future beauty
cards.access_notes: Publicly accessible path; best used during daylight hours.

cards.title: The Historic Forum
cards.subtitle: Old Main
cards.notes: Study in the heart of campus history. This renovated space offers modern technology within the college's most iconic building.
cards.short_summary: A modernized forum and study space located inside the historic Old Main building.
cards.evidence_claim: The interior of Old Main was renovated to include modernized classrooms, computer kiosks, and a forum space.
cards.source_title: Old Main | Augustana College
cards.access_notes: Open during academic building hours; elevator access requires special permission.

cards.title: The Upper Campus Lounges
cards.subtitle: Westerlin Residence Center
cards.notes: Utilize the common area lounges for late-night study sessions without leaving your residence hall on the upper campus.
cards.short_summary: Common area lounges in the largest residence hall, providing convenient study space for upper campus residents.
cards.evidence_claim: Westerlin Hall features lounges and common areas that provide a change of environment for students to study.
cards.source_title: Best study spots on campus | Augustana College
cards.access_notes: Primarily for residents; accessible 24/7 for students living in the hall.

boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Explore Augustana College's best free social and study spots, from historic landmarks and specialized museums to scenic nature paths and community lounges.

cards.title: Fryxell Geology Museum
cards.subtitle: Swenson Hall of Geosciences
cards.notes: View a 22-foot-long Cryolophosaurus skeleton and a massive collection of minerals and fossils. Admission is free for students and the public during the academic year.
cards.short_summary: A free campus museum featuring dinosaur skeletons and one of the largest mineral collections in the Midwest.
cards.evidence_claim: The museum is open 8 a.m. to 4:30 p.m. Monday-Friday and 1-4 p.m. Saturday and Sunday during the academic year. Free admission.
cards.source_title: Fryxell Geology Museum | Augustana College
cards.access_notes: Open Mon-Fri 8:00 AM - 4:30 PM, Sat-Sun 1:00 PM - 4:00 PM during the academic year. Closed in summer.

cards.title: The Slough Path
cards.subtitle: Campus Waterway
cards.notes: Stroll along the scenic pathway connecting upper and lower campus. It is a popular spot for relaxing in the gazebo or watching the changing autumn leaves.
cards.short_summary: A central campus waterway and walking path used for recreation and scenic commutes between residence halls.
cards.evidence_claim: The Slough Path is expected to remain open for campus and community use through the fall semester.
cards.source_title: Slough drainage, restoration project ensures future beauty - Augustana College
cards.access_notes: Publicly accessible outdoor walking path open daily.

cards.title: Center for Visual Culture
cards.subtitle: Bergendoff Hall of Fine Arts
cards.notes: Browse rotating art exhibitions and senior inquiry projects. The gallery serves as a quiet, inspiring space for students to appreciate local and student-made art.
cards.short_summary: The college's primary art gallery featuring preservation and exhibition of diverse visual works.
cards.evidence_claim: The Augustana Center for Visual Culture is open Monday through Thursday: 7 a.m.-11 p.m.; Friday and Saturday: 7 a.m.-6 p.m.; Sunday: Noon-11 p.m.
cards.source_title: Augustana Center for Visual Culture
cards.access_notes: Open daily during the academic year with late hours until 11:00 PM on most nights.

cards.title: Tredway Library Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Group Study Spaces
cards.notes: Reserve a private room for group projects or quiet study. Rooms on the 2nd and 3rd floors offer whiteboards and PCs for collaborative work without any rental fees.
cards.short_summary: Free bookable study rooms for students, faculty, and staff within the main campus library.
cards.evidence_claim: Study rooms are free to use for current Augustana College students, faculty, and staff.
cards.source_title: Space Availability - Tredway Library - LibCal - Augustana College
cards.access_notes: Available during library hours; reservations are limited to 4 hours per day for current students.

cards.title: Old Main Forum
cards.subtitle: Historic Landmark
cards.notes: Visit the most iconic building on campus to use the modernized forum space or computer kiosks. It's a historic spot for quiet reading between humanities classes.
cards.short_summary: The historic heart of campus, housing humanities departments and open forum spaces for students.
cards.evidence_claim: Old Main is home to Classics, English, philosophy... creating a forum space. Open during the academic year.
cards.source_title: Old Main | Augustana College
cards.access_notes: Open during standard academic building hours; elevator access requires special permission.

cards.title: Swenson Center Exhibits
cards.subtitle: Denkmann Memorial Building
cards.notes: Explore the reading room's rotating exhibits on Swedish-American history. It is a unique, quiet space for cultural research and viewing primary source artifacts.
cards.short_summary: A research center and archive featuring free public exhibits on Swedish immigration and history.
cards.evidence_claim: The Swenson Center has created digital versions of the exhibits in its reading room since 2012. Exhibits explore a variety of topics.
cards.source_title: Exhibits - Swenson Swedish Immigration Research Center
cards.access_notes: Reading room exhibits are accessible during center hours, typically Mon-Fri.

cards.title: Westerlin Activity Center
cards.subtitle: AugiePlex
cards.notes: Access cardio and weight training equipment or the dance studio. This upper-campus hub is free for students to stay active without a separate gym membership.
cards.short_summary: A student fitness and activity center located within the Westerlin Residence Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Westerlin Athletic Center (AugiePlex) has equipment for cardio and weight training... open for use.
cards.source_title: Westerlin Hall | Augustana College
cards.access_notes: Open Mon-Thu until 10:00 PM, Sun until 10:00 PM. Requires Augustana ID for entry.

cards.title: PepsiCo Rec Center Courts
cards.subtitle: Indoor Athletics
cards.notes: Play basketball, tennis, or racquetball on the indoor courts. It is a great spot for late-night pickup games or meeting friends for intramural sports.
cards.short_summary: A large multi-purpose recreation facility offering free court access for the campus community.
cards.evidence_claim: The PepsiCo Rec Center and Westerlin Activity Center are open for use... Monday-Thursday: 7 a.m.-10 p.m.
cards.source_title: PepsiCo and Westerlin Activity Center hours - Augustana College
cards.access_notes: Open Mon-Thu 7:00 AM - 10:00 PM, Fri 7:00 AM - 7:00 PM, Sat 9:00 AM - 6:00 PM, Sun 10:00 AM - 10:00 PM.

cards.title: Paul V. Olsen Track
cards.subtitle: Knowlton Athletic Complex
cards.notes: Run or walk on the high-quality synthetic track when not in use by athletic teams. It offers a professional-grade surface for personal fitness outdoors.
cards.short_summary: The outdoor track at Lindberg Stadium, available for student and community use during non-event hours.
cards.evidence_claim: The Paul V. Olsen Track was installed in 2019... part of the Knowlton Outdoor Athletic Complex.
cards.source_title: Austin E. Knowlton Outdoor Athletic Complex | Augustana College
cards.access_notes: Open for public use when not reserved for intercollegiate athletics or classes.

cards.title: The Brew Patio
cards.subtitle: Tredway Library 4th Floor
cards.notes: Hang out on the outdoor patio overlooking the Slough. While the cafe sells snacks, the seating area and patio are free for students to socialize and study.
cards.short_summary: A popular social hub with a scenic outdoor patio located on the top floor of the library.
cards.evidence_claim: And when the weather is nice, there are tables outside on the patio... a great place to study.
cards.source_title: Best study spots on campus | Augustana College
cards.access_notes: Accessible during library and cafe operating hours.

boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Discover a range of focused environments across the Rock Island campus, from silent library floors to collaborative science labs and social cafes.

cards.title: Silent Study on the First Floor
cards.subtitle: Quiet Zone in Thomas Tredway Library
cards.notes: Utilize this designated quiet floor for minimal distractions. It is ideal for deep focus and individual research within the main campus library.
cards.short_summary: A designated quiet floor in the Thomas Tredway Library for silent, individual study.
cards.evidence_claim: The first floor of the Tredway Library is a designated 'quiet floor' where students do not speak to maintain focus.
cards.source_title: Best study spots on campus | Augustana College
cards.access_notes: Open during regular library hours; silent noise policy strictly enforced.

cards.title: Coffee and Collaboration at The Brew
cards.subtitle: Social Study Spot in Gerber Center
cards.notes: Grab a coffee and find a booth or table in this active social space. Outdoor patio seating is available during warmer months for a change of scenery.
cards.short_summary: A social cafe and study area located on the fourth floor of the Gerber Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Brew by the Slough is a campus coffee shop on the fourth floor of the Tredway Library/Gerber Center with tables, booths, and an outdoor patio.
cards.source_title: Best study spots on campus | Augustana College
cards.access_notes: Active social environment; open during Gerber Center operating hours.

cards.title: Collaborative Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Reservable Spaces in Tredway Library
cards.notes: Reserve one of eleven rooms for group projects. Second-floor rooms accommodate 4-10 people and include whiteboards; markers are available at the desk.
cards.short_summary: Reservable group study rooms in the Tredway Library equipped with whiteboards and tech.
cards.evidence_claim: The library offers 11 reservable study rooms; 2nd-floor rooms require groups of 4-10 people and include whiteboards.
cards.source_title: Space Availability - Tredway Library - LibCal - Augustana College
cards.access_notes: Reservations required via LibCal; 4-hour daily limit per patron.

cards.title: Science Center Collaboration Hubs
cards.subtitle: Study Areas in Hanson Hall of Science
cards.notes: Find open seating and discussion areas near faculty offices. These spaces are designed for collaborative work and peer-led research discussions.
cards.short_summary: Collaborative study and discussion spaces located within the Hanson Hall of Science.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hanson Hall expansion includes faculty offices with adjoining space for discussion and collaboration.
cards.source_title: Inside the Hanson expansion | Augustana College
cards.access_notes: Open during building hours; primarily used by science students but open to all.

cards.title: Central Campus Study in Evald
cards.subtitle: Lobby Seating in Carlsson-Evald Hall
cards.notes: Use the lobby seating for quick study sessions between classes. This central location is convenient for students with courses in the various departments housed here.
cards.short_summary: A convenient lobby study area located in the centrally-located Carlsson-Evald Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: The Evald lobby is listed as one of the top study spots on campus.
cards.source_title: Best study spots on campus | Augustana College
cards.access_notes: Public lobby area; best for casual or short-term study.

cards.title: Wellness-Focused Study Areas
cards.subtitle: Gathering Spaces in Lindberg Center
cards.notes: Study in a modern environment focused on health and human performance. The center features dedicated student and faculty gathering and studying spaces.
cards.short_summary: Modern study and gathering spaces within the Peter J. Lindberg, M.D., Center.
cards.evidence_claim: The Lindberg Center includes multi-use student and faculty gathering and studying spaces.
cards.source_title: The Peter J. Lindberg, M.D., Center for Health and Human Performance
cards.access_notes: Open during building hours; includes a meditation room nearby for quiet breaks.

cards.title: Fine Arts Focused Study
cards.subtitle: New Study Spaces in Bergendoff Hall
cards.notes: Take advantage of newly renovated study and practice rooms. These spaces are ideal for music students or anyone needing a quiet, creative environment.
cards.short_summary: Renovated study and practice rooms located in the Bergendoff Hall of Fine Arts.
cards.evidence_claim: The Bergendoff Hall transformation included the addition of designated practice rooms and study rooms.
cards.source_title: Take a look! Bergendoff Hall transformed | Augustana College
cards.access_notes: Open to all students; priority may be given to fine arts majors for certain rooms.

cards.title: Historic Atmosphere in Old Main
cards.subtitle: Classroom Study in the Iconic Landmark
cards.notes: Study in the college's most iconic building. When not in use for classes, the state-of-the-art classrooms provide a quiet and historic setting for work.
cards.short_summary: Quiet study opportunities within the historic and renovated classrooms of Old Main.
cards.evidence_claim: Old Main features state-of-the-art classrooms and is home to multiple academic departments.
cards.source_title: Campus Building Sparknotes | Augustana College
cards.access_notes: Available when classes are not in session; building typically closes in the evening.

cards.title: Academic Support at Olin
cards.subtitle: Learning Commons in Olin Center
cards.notes: Visit the Learning Commons for academic coaching or tutoring. The space is designed for both individualized instruction and collaborative group work.
cards.short_summary: An academic support hub in the Olin Center offering tutoring and group study space.
cards.evidence_claim: The Learning Commons main office is located in Olin 320 and offers individualized or group instruction.
cards.source_title: The Learning Commons | Augustana College
cards.access_notes: Open during business hours; tutoring appointments can be scheduled via Starfish.

cards.title: Late Night Study in Erickson
cards.subtitle: Lounge Area in Erickson Hall
cards.notes: Head to the Erickson basement for a change of environment. It features plenty of chairs and tables, making it a reliable spot for collaborative evening sessions.
cards.short_summary: A spacious basement lounge in Erickson Residence Center equipped for student study.
cards.evidence_claim: Erickson has a basement with plenty of chairs and tables set up for students to work.
cards.source_title: Best study spots on campus | Augustana College
cards.access_notes: Accessible to residents; non-residents may need to be swiped in.

boards.title: 10 Blocks Off Campus, One Reason Each
boards.description: Explore the corridors and micro-districts surrounding Augustana College, from the historic Hilltop neighborhood to the cultural hub of The District.

cards.title: College Hill District
cards.subtitle: 14th Avenue Corridor
cards.notes: Walk this eclectic neighborhood bordering campus to find local favorites like Fred & Ethel's 50's Antiques and Happy Joe's Pizza.
cards.short_summary: A walkable business district on the southern edge of campus known for its mid-century buildings and local shops.
cards.evidence_claim: The College Hill District is a walkable neighborhood composed of two distinct nodes along 14th Avenue, bordering the southern edge of the Augustana College campus.
cards.source_title: College Hill District | Rock Island, IL - RIGOV.org
cards.access_notes: Publicly accessible street-level district; individual business hours vary.

cards.title: The District
cards.subtitle: 2nd Avenue Corridor
cards.notes: Visit Rock Island's cultural heart to explore art galleries and the Quad City Arts center, easily accessible via the free MetroLink bus.
cards.short_summary: Downtown Rock Island's arts and entertainment hub featuring galleries, theaters, and local retail.
cards.evidence_claim: The District is located about one kilometer from campus and serves as the city's cultural heart, featuring art galleries and live music.
cards.source_title: The District | Augustana College
cards.access_notes: Open to the public; students can ride MetroLink for free with ID to reach this area.

cards.title: 38th Street
cards.subtitle: Campus Main Artery
cards.notes: Navigate this central thoroughfare to reach the Brunner Theatre Center and the main campus entrance from the south.
cards.short_summary: The primary north-south road running through the Augustana campus, connecting residential areas to academic buildings.
cards.evidence_claim: 38th Street is the main artery for Augustana, where students pass Swanson Commons and reach Centennial Hall at the 7th Avenue signal.
cards.source_title: Getting to campus | Augustana College
cards.access_notes: Public city street passing through the heart of the college campus.

cards.title: 7th Avenue
cards.subtitle: Northern Campus Edge
cards.notes: Walk along this street to access Centennial Hall and the northern parking facilities near the Slough path.
cards.short_summary: A major east-west street that defines the northern boundary of the main campus area.
cards.evidence_claim: 7th Avenue is a key street at the northern edge of campus where Centennial Hall and its parking lot are located.
cards.source_title: Augustana College Campus Map
cards.access_notes: Public thoroughfare; sidewalk access to campus buildings and the Slough.

cards.title: 30th Street
cards.subtitle: Hilltop Revitalization Zone
cards.notes: Explore the western edge of the Hilltop neighborhood where new community development projects are revitalizing local properties.
cards.short_summary: A key north-south street on the west side of the Hilltop district being developed for mixed-use retail.
cards.evidence_claim: The Hilltop CDC has purchased property at 30th Street and 14th Avenue, a five-minute walk from the southern edge of campus.
cards.source_title: Revitalization begins in College Hill | Augustana College
cards.access_notes: Public street area; currently undergoing neighborhood revitalization efforts.

cards.title: 11th Street
cards.subtitle: Embassy Square Corridor
cards.notes: Head west to this commercial strip to find local services and the Chopsticks House Chinese Restaurant at Embassy Square.
cards.short_summary: A commercial corridor west of campus featuring local shopping centers and dining options.
cards.evidence_claim: Embassy Square Mall is located at 2365-2409 11th Street and features various shops and restaurants.
cards.source_title: Contact | Embassy Square Mall
cards.access_notes: Public commercial street and shopping center; business hours vary.

cards.title: 4th Avenue
cards.subtitle: Downtown Dining Block
cards.notes: Stop by this downtown block for a caffeine fix at Awake Coffee Company or to explore local eateries near the riverfront.
cards.short_summary: A downtown street known for student-friendly coffee shops and proximity to the Mississippi riverfront.
cards.evidence_claim: Awake Coffee Company is located at 1430 4th Avenue in Downtown Rock Island.
cards.source_title: Downtown Rock Island Food And Drink Options
cards.access_notes: Public downtown street; coffee shop and restaurants have standard retail hours.

cards.title: 6th Avenue
cards.subtitle: Columbia Park Corridor
cards.notes: Check out the newer retail developments and strip centers located along this high-traffic artery near the campus edge.
cards.short_summary: A busy commercial corridor north of campus featuring modern retail and office spaces.
cards.evidence_claim: LRC Real Estate has developed a strip center at 4015 6th Avenue, adjacent to Augustana College.
cards.source_title: Our New Rock Island Development - LRC Real Estate
cards.access_notes: Public street with commercial parking lots for retail customers.

cards.title: 10th Avenue
cards.subtitle: Residential Hall Row
cards.notes: Walk this quiet residential street to reach the Westerlin Residence Center and the campus public radio station, WVIK.
cards.short_summary: A residential street housing major student dormitories and the college's public radio facilities.
cards.evidence_claim: The Westerlin Residence Center is located at 3200 10th Avenue on the Augustana campus.
cards.source_title: Buildings and facilities | Augustana College
cards.access_notes: Public street; residence hall access restricted to students and authorized guests.

cards.title: 42nd Street
cards.subtitle: Eastern Hilltop Boundary
cards.notes: Explore the eastern end of the College Hill District where the neighborhood transitions into local residential blocks.
cards.short_summary: The eastern boundary of the College Hill business district near the campus athletic complex.
cards.evidence_claim: The College Hill District boundaries are concentrated at the intersections of 14th Avenue with 30th Street and 37th to 42nd Streets.
cards.source_title: College Hill District | Rock Island, IL - RIGOV.org
cards.access_notes: Public street-level neighborhood area.

boards.title: Only Happens Here: 10 Traditions That Make No Sense Anywhere Else
boards.description: From Swedish holiday festivals to cardboard boat races in the campus slough, Augustana College maintains a unique set of traditions rooted in its Lutheran heritage and tight-knit community.

cards.title: The Senior Slough Jump
cards.subtitle: A muddy graduation rite of passage
cards.notes: Graduating seniors celebrate by jumping into the campus slough. While officially restricted, the college permits approved entries for graduation and major achievements.
cards.short_summary: A tradition where graduating seniors jump into the campus slough to celebrate their achievement.
cards.evidence_claim: The college's social conduct policy notes that campus organizations may utilize the pond for traditions such as celebrating graduation with approved brief entries.
cards.source_title: Social Conduct - Augustana College
cards.access_notes: The Slough is a central campus feature; jumping is restricted to approved student events.

cards.title: Homecoming Cardboard Regatta
cards.subtitle: Racing handmade boats across the slough
cards.notes: Student groups build boats using only cardboard and duct tape to race across the slough during Homecoming week. Staying afloat is the primary challenge.
cards.short_summary: A competitive Homecoming event where students race cardboard boats across the campus slough.
cards.evidence_claim: The Office of Student Life lists the 'legendary Cardboard Regatta' as a key annual Homecoming tradition held at the slough.
cards.source_title: Homecoming | Augustana College
cards.access_notes: Public viewing is available along the Slough Path during Homecoming week.

cards.title: Festival of Sankta Lucia
cards.subtitle: A Swedish celebration of light
cards.notes: This annual December event honors the college's Swedish roots with a candlelight procession led by a student wearing a crown of seven candles.
cards.short_summary: A traditional Swedish festival of light featuring a candlelight procession and Scandinavian carols.
cards.evidence_claim: The Festival of Sankta Lucia is a cherished holiday tradition at Augustana where a student portrays Lucia with a crown of candles.
cards.source_title: Holiday traditions at Augustana College
cards.access_notes: Held annually in early December at Ascension Chapel; free and open to the public.

cards.title: The Bell Tower Lore
cards.subtitle: A promise of forever under the klockstapel
cards.notes: Campus legend suggests that couples who kiss under the Swedish-style bell tower are destined to marry. It is a popular spot for proposals and wedding photos.
cards.short_summary: A romantic campus legend involving the Swedish-style bell tower and future marriage.
cards.evidence_claim: Student media and historical records document the lore that kissing under the bell tower leads to a successful relationship and marriage.
cards.source_title: Augustana Bell Tower holds history and tradition
cards.access_notes: The free-standing bell tower is located at the foot of Zion Hill and is accessible 24/7.

cards.title: Last Lecture and Senior Toast
cards.subtitle: Final words and a commemorative flute
cards.notes: Seniors gather to hear 'last lectures' from three favorite professors. The event concludes with a champagne toast led by the college president.
cards.short_summary: A graduation-week event featuring lectures from student-selected professors and a formal toast.
cards.evidence_claim: The annual Last Lecture and Senior Toast includes a champagne toast by the President and the distribution of commemorative flutes.
cards.source_title: Last Lecture and Senior Toast | Augustana College
cards.access_notes: Typically held in Centennial Hall during Commencement week; requires government ID for champagne.

cards.title: Augustana Bingo Night
cards.subtitle: High-stakes campus gaming
cards.notes: One of the most popular recurring social events on campus, Bingo Night often features large cash prizes (up to $500) and draws hundreds of students.
cards.short_summary: A highly popular student social event featuring competitive bingo and significant cash prizes.
cards.evidence_claim: The Student Life Programming Board's bingo is described as one of the most popular events at Augustana with $500 cash prizes.
cards.source_title: Bingo | Augustana College
cards.access_notes: Held in the Gävle Rooms of the Gerber Center; free for all Augustana students.

cards.title: Joy of Christmas in Andover
cards.subtitle: A candlelit pilgrimage to the historic chapel
cards.notes: Students and faculty travel to nearby Andover for a multilingual service that ends with a candlelit procession to the historic 1850s Jenny Lind Chapel.
cards.short_summary: A holiday worship service and candlelit procession held at the historic Jenny Lind Chapel in Andover.
cards.evidence_claim: The 'Joy of Christmas' service concludes with a procession to the Jenny Lind Chapel, which is illuminated by 100 candles.
cards.source_title: Christmas at Augustana, other holiday events planned
cards.access_notes: Located in Andover, IL; transportation is often provided for students. Open to the public.

cards.title: The Homecoming Rope Pull
cards.subtitle: Tug-of-war for campus bragging rights
cards.notes: A long-standing Homecoming tradition where student organizations, particularly Greek groups, compete in a massive tug-of-war tournament.
cards.short_summary: A traditional Homecoming tug-of-war competition between various student organizations.
cards.evidence_claim: Annual Homecoming traditions include the Rope Pull, which has been a staple of the week's celebrations for decades.
cards.source_title: Homecoming | Augustana College
cards.access_notes: Held at Ericson Field or near the Slough during Homecoming week; free for spectators.

cards.title: Phrig Painting
cards.subtitle: Creative bedsheet banners
cards.notes: Students and Greek groups paint 'phrigs' (large bedsheet banners) to display campus spirit, promote events, or compete in Homecoming contests.
cards.short_summary: A tradition of creating and displaying painted bedsheet banners for campus events and spirit.
cards.evidence_claim: The Augustana Observer and college records mention 'phrig painting' as a common activity for student groups and Homecoming competitions.
cards.source_title: 100 years of siblinghood: Chi Omega Gamma and Rho Nu Delta celebrate their centennial
cards.access_notes: Phrigs are typically displayed on the Quad or outside residence halls during major event weeks.

cards.title: Christmas Tree Lighting
cards.subtitle: Illuminating the heart of campus
cards.notes: A festive gathering behind Old Main where the campus Christmas tree is lit, accompanied by carols from an alumni choir and a luminary-lit path.
cards.short_summary: An annual holiday event featuring the lighting of the campus Christmas tree and community caroling.
cards.evidence_claim: The Christmas Tree Lighting takes place on the Quad behind Old Main and includes a luminary-lit path and carols.
cards.source_title: Augustana holiday traditions
cards.access_notes: Held in early December on the Quad; free and open to the entire community.

boards.title: Your First Weekend at Augustana College, Shared as Cards
boards.description: Navigate your first days as a Viking with this sequence of essential campus stops, from the opening convocation to late-night snacks.

cards.title: Attend Opening Convocation
cards.subtitle: Friday Afternoon Kick-off
cards.notes: Join the Class of 2030 at Lindberg Stadium for the official welcome from President Talentino. This required event marks the start of your academic journey.
cards.short_summary: The official welcome ceremony for new students held at the football stadium.
cards.evidence_claim: Opening Convocation for the Class of 2030 is scheduled for Friday, Aug. 28, 2026, at 1 p.m. at Charles D. Lindberg Stadium.
cards.source_title: Welcome Week | Augustana College
cards.access_notes: Required for all new students; seating is in the north bleachers.

cards.title: Lunch at Gerber Center
cards.subtitle: First On-Campus Meal
cards.notes: Head to the top floor of the Gerber Center for a complimentary lunch with your family and new peers before the afternoon sessions begin.
cards.short_summary: The primary campus dining hall featuring multiple international food stations.
cards.evidence_claim: Complimentary lunch for students and families is served in the Gerber Center Dining Room from 11 a.m. to 12:45 p.m. on move-in Friday.
cards.source_title: Welcome Week | Augustana College
cards.access_notes: Open daily; weekend hours are typically 9 a.m. to 7 p.m. or 8 p.m.

cards.title: Pick Up Your Viking Gear
cards.subtitle: Brunner Theatre Center Lower Level
cards.notes: Visit the bookstore to grab your textbooks and Augustana apparel. It stays open throughout the first weekend to accommodate new arrivals.
cards.short_summary: The official campus store for textbooks, supplies, and college-branded merchandise.
cards.evidence_claim: The bookstore is open Friday 8 a.m.-4:30 p.m., Saturday 10 a.m.-4 p.m., and Sunday 1-3 p.m. during Welcome Week.
cards.source_title: Welcome Week | Augustana College
cards.access_notes: Located in the lower level of the Brunner Theatre Center.

cards.title: Walk the Slough Path
cards.subtitle: Evening Campus Stroll
cards.notes: Take a walk along the iconic Slough path that connects the residential and academic sides of campus. Look for turtles and frogs in the water.
cards.short_summary: A central campus waterway and landmark with a paved walking path.
cards.evidence_claim: The Slough is a historic campus landmark with a pathway connecting residential and academic areas.
cards.source_title: Slough water ebbs and flows through history at Augustana
cards.access_notes: Outdoor public path accessible 24/7.

cards.title: Explore Campus Recreation
cards.subtitle: Saturday Morning Workout
cards.notes: Check out the 200-meter track and basketball courts. It's a great spot to meet people through intramural sports or open gym hours.
cards.short_summary: The main student recreation facility featuring courts, a track, and a weight room.
cards.evidence_claim: PepsiCo Recreation Center is open Saturdays from 9 a.m. to 6 p.m. and Sundays from 10 a.m. to 10 p.m.
cards.source_title: PepsiCo Recreation Center | Augustana College
cards.access_notes: Requires Augustana ID for entry.

cards.title: Visit the Dinosaur Gallery
cards.subtitle: Saturday Afternoon Culture
cards.notes: See the 22-foot long Cryolophosaurus skeleton and other fossils. This museum is one of the finest geology collections in the Midwest.
cards.short_summary: A campus museum housing extensive rock, mineral, and fossil specimens.
cards.evidence_claim: The Fryxell Geology Museum is open Saturdays and Sundays from 1 p.m. to 4 p.m. when classes are in session.
cards.source_title: Fryxell Geology Museum | Augustana College
cards.access_notes: Located in the Swenson Hall of Geosciences.

cards.title: Find Your Study Spot
cards.subtitle: Sunday Prep Session
cards.notes: Explore the four floors of the library to find your favorite study nook before classes start on Monday. The Learning Commons is also located here.
cards.short_summary: The central academic library and hub for student success services.
cards.evidence_claim: Thomas Tredway Library is the main campus library and houses the Learning Commons.
cards.source_title: Thomas Tredway Library | Augustana College
cards.access_notes: Check LibCal for specific weekend hours; typically open until late evening on Sundays.

cards.title: Photo Op at Old Main
cards.subtitle: Iconic Campus Landmark
cards.notes: Snap a photo in front of the copper-domed Old Main. It's the most historic building on campus and houses many humanities departments.
cards.short_summary: The historic, copper-domed centerpiece of the Augustana campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Old Main is the most iconic building on campus, built between 1884 and 1893.
cards.source_title: Old Main | Augustana College
cards.access_notes: Exterior is always accessible; interior open during academic hours.

cards.title: Coffee at The Brew
cards.subtitle: Casual Sunday Afternoon
cards.notes: Grab a latte and a pastry at this campus coffee shop. It's a popular spot for casual meetings and has a great outdoor patio.
cards.short_summary: A campus coffee shop offering drinks, pastries, and grab-and-go food.
cards.evidence_claim: Brew by the Slough is located in the Gerber Center and is open Saturdays and Sundays from 11 a.m. to 3 p.m.
cards.source_title: Dining locations and hours | Augustana College
cards.access_notes: Located on the fourth floor of the Gerber Center.

cards.title: Late Night Snack Run
cards.subtitle: Sunday Night Essentials
cards.notes: Stock up on snacks for your first week of classes. This convenience store is open late on Sunday nights for last-minute needs.
cards.short_summary: A campus convenience store located near the residence halls.
cards.evidence_claim: Westerlin Market is open from 2 p.m. to midnight on Sundays.
cards.source_title: Dining locations and hours | Augustana College
cards.access_notes: Located in the Westerlin Residence Hall complex.
